verdict.rationale: Paddle's docs comprehensively cover setting up subscription checkouts, plans/prices, pausing subscriptions, and upgrading/downgrading (including changing base plan and billing frequency) via replacing products/prices, plus sales-assisted invoicing and dunning for failed payments — a solid recurring-billing foundation. missing for 10: explicit documentation of free-trial period setup and how proration is calculated/applied on plan changes (evidence only implies plan-change mechanics without naming proration).
